name: Flash Freeze Lake · Arcane
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 7-block radius for 4.5 s (water and ground beneath turn to ice). Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 3 ❤ arcane
• Soaked for 16.5 s
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Arcane instability: −0.75 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 16.5 s and leaves a puddle
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4 s
